job.description:
Job Title

Legionella Risk Assessor | London & South East


Summary Are you an experienced Legionella Risk Assessor looking to join a growing and ambitious water hygiene specialist? Do you want to work for a company that genuinely invests in training, development and career progression?


We're recruiting for a Legionella Risk Assessor to support a portfolio of commercial, public sector and industrial clients across London and the South East. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong technical background in risk assessment who wants to develop their expertise and progress within a growing business.


The Company

• Established specialist in Legionella compliance, water hygiene and water treatment services.

• Strong reputation for delivering high-quality compliance solutions across the UK.

• Growing business with exciting expansion plans and excellent long-term career prospects.

• Supportive and collaborative culture with a focus on employee development.

• Diverse client portfolio spanning commercial, education, industrial and public sector environments.

• Ongoing investment in training, qualifications and professional development.


The Job

• Carry out Legionella Risk Assessments across a variety of client sites throughout London and the South East.

• Assess domestic hot and cold-water systems and other water systems in line with current legislation and guidance.

• Produce clear, detailed and technically robust risk assessment reports.

• Identify compliance issues and provide practical recommendations for remedial actions and risk reduction.

• Create and update schematic drawings to accurately reflect water system layouts.

• Build strong working relationships with clients, explaining findings and recommendations clearly and professionally.

• Manage your own diary and workload, travelling between sites while maintaining high standards of service delivery.

• Support ongoing compliance programmes and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


The Ideal Candidate

• Previous experience as a Legionella Risk Assessor or within the water hygiene industry.

• City & Guilds Legionella Risk Assessment qualification or equivalent.

• Good working knowledge of ACOP L8 and HSG274 guidance.

• Experience producing or interpreting schematic drawings of water systems.

• Understanding of domestic hot and cold-water systems; experience with cooling towers or other water systems would be advantageous.

• Excellent report writing and communication skills.

• Self-motivated, organised and capable of working independently.

• Full UK driving licence.

• Based within approximately one hour of Central London.


Particularly Interested In Candidates With:

• 2+ years' Legionella Risk Assessment experience.

• Strong knowledge of HSG274 Parts 1, 2 and/or 3.

• Experience assessing cooling towers, process water systems, water features or other specialist systems.

• Understanding of HTM 04-01 guidance (advantageous but not essential).

• Membership of, or engagement with, relevant industry bodies such as the Water Management Society.


What You Get

• Up to £40,000 basic salary (depending on experience).

• Company vehicle.

• Pension scheme.

• Healthcare benefits.

• Employee Assistance Programme.

• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.

• Ongoing training, qualifications and career development opportunities.

• Flexible and supportive working environment.

• Clear progression routes within a growing business.

job.title: Water Treatment Engineer
job.description:
Water Treatment Engineer

£35,000–£45,000 + Package

Watford / Southern England


Experienced Water Treatment Engineer looking for your next challenge?

We're working with a leading specialist engineering business that is looking to appoint an experienced Water Treatment Engineer to join its team.


This is a field-based role covering Southern England, working with commercial and industrial customers and providing hands-on technical support across a range of water treatment systems.


You'll be responsible for installing, servicing, maintaining and repairing water treatment equipment, while developing strong relationships with customers across your region.


The Role

You'll work across a variety of water treatment systems and equipment, including:

  • Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems
  • Water softeners
  • Deionisation / DI systems
  • Filtration equipment
  • Pumps and associated equipment
  • Valves and mechanical components
  • Water treatment plant and ancillary equipment


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Installing and commissioning water treatment equipment
  • Carrying out planned preventative maintenance and servicing
  • Diagnosing faults and carrying out repairs
  • Fault-finding across mechanical and water treatment systems
  • Replacing pumps, valves, membranes, filters and other components
  • Carrying out system modifications and remedial works
  • Testing and commissioning equipment
  • Completing detailed service reports
  • Providing technical support and advice to customers
  • Ensuring work is completed safely and to a high standard
  • Travelling throughout Southern England to customer sites


About You

We're looking for an experienced engineer with a strong background in mechanical engineering and/or water treatment.

You may currently be working as a:

Water Treatment Engineer | Service Engineer | Field Service Engineer | Mechanical Engineer | Mechanical Fitter | Mechanical Pipefitter | Installation Engineer | Commissioning Engineer


You'll ideally have experience with some of the following:

  • Water treatment equipment
  • Reverse Osmosis
  • Water softeners
  • DI / demineralisation
  • Pumps and valves
  • Mechanical pipework
  • Installation and commissioning
  • Planned and reactive maintenance
  • Fault-finding and repairs


We're also happy to consider strong mechanical engineers or pipefitters who have the practical skills required and are interested in developing their career within water treatment.
